entries.title: Z Homing Failed
entries.fix: Power off. Check the Z limit switch at the gantry bottom, clean if dusty. Power on and retry. If persistent, sensor may be faulty.

entries.title: Nozzle Cooldown Timeout Before Homing
entries.fix: Allow the nozzle to cool naturally (~50°C). Or manually speed up the cooling fan. Retry. If fan is not spinning, that's the root cause.

entries.title: Auto Bed Leveling Failed
entries.fix: Power off and clear any debris. Wipe the build plate clean. Check that the nozzle spins freely without obstruction. Power on and retry ABL. If repeated, probe may be faulty.

entries.title: Nozzle Cooling Fan Abnormal
entries.fix: Power off. Inspect fan blades for dust or blockage, clean gently with a soft brush. Try spinning by hand. If broken, replace the fan assembly.

entries.title: Nozzle Clogged
entries.fix: Heat to 220°C. Use a fine needle to gently clear the orifice. Do not force, brass nozzles are soft. Or soak in acetone for stubborn residue.

entries.title: AMS Slot Switching Failure
entries.fix: Verify that the AMS motor and mechanical components move freely without obstruction. Check for filament tangles in the material path. Power-cycle the printer.

entries.title: XY Homing Failed
entries.fix: Power off. Manually move the printhead to center (gently). Check belts for tangles or misalignment. Verify limit switches. Power on and retry.

entries.title: Resonance Frequency Identification Failed
entries.fix: Check belt tension on X, Y, Z, should be moderate, not slack. Verify bearing smoothness. Power-cycle. If persists, calibration module may be faulty.

entries.title: Print Cancelled
entries.fix: Job ended. Clean the bed and send a new print if desired.

entries.title: Print Resume Failed
entries.fix: Unload filament and cancel. Resend the print from the start.

entries.title: Motor Self-Check Failed
entries.fix: Power cycle the printer to re-run self-test. Check motor wiring for loose connections. If error persists, control board may be faulty.

entries.title: Print Paused Without Reason
entries.fix: Visually inspect the printer and print. If nothing appears wrong, click Resume.

entries.title: Print Paused by User
entries.fix: Perform any maintenance if needed. Click Resume when ready.

entries.title: First Layer Defects (Micro Lidar Scan)
entries.fix: Check bed temperature (60°C typical) and nozzle-to-bed distance. If minor, resume. If significant, stop and clean the plate.

entries.title: Spaghetti Defects Detected
entries.fix: Pause and inspect the first layer, check adhesion. Verify bed temperature (typically 60°C). Clean the plate and retry. Check slicer settings for speed/extrusion.

entries.title: Filament Supply Exhausted
entries.fix: Load a new filament spool into the AMS slot and retry the print job.

entries.title: Toolhead Mechanical or Communication Issue
entries.fix: Verify that the toolhead front cover is properly installed. If it is missing or damaged, order a replacement. For communication errors, power-cycle the printer and check ribbon cable connections.

entries.title: Build Plate Marker Not Detected
entries.fix: Power off and remove the build plate. Check the marker, if worn or missing, replace it. Clean the Lidar lens with a microfiber cloth. Reinstall plate firmly at all corners.

entries.title: Unfinished Print After Power Loss
entries.fix: Check: is the model still stuck to the bed? If yes, click Resume. If fallen off, clean bed and restart.

entries.title: Nozzle Temperature Malfunction
entries.fix: Check the thermistor cable for loose connections. If cracked or damaged, replace. Power-cycle the printer. If unresolved, sensor replacement needed.

entries.title: Heated Bed Temperature Malfunction
entries.fix: Power off. Check the bed thermistor cable, reseat if loose. If damaged, replace. Power on. If unresolved, sensor replacement needed.

entries.title: Filament Pile-up in Waste Chute
entries.fix: Stop the print and empty the waste chute. Remove all accumulated filament scraps. Clear the opening. Resume.

entries.title: Filament Cutter Malfunction
entries.fix: Physically inspect the cutter handle to ensure it is in the correct position. Remove any filament debris or obstructions. If the problem persists, contact Bambu Lab support.

entries.title: Stepper Motor Skipping Detected
entries.fix: Auto-recovery was attempted. Check: belt tension, bearing smoothness, motor heat. Resume if safe. If repeated, stepper may be failing.

entries.title: Objects Fallen or Extrusion Failure
entries.fix: Inspect the model. Minor defects, resume. Major defects, cancel and check bed temp/adhesion.

entries.title: Door Opened
entries.fix: Close the door firmly (should click). Click Resume.

entries.title: Build Plate Type Mismatch
entries.fix: Verify the correct build plate type is installed (textured, smooth, or PEI). If wrong, swap. Or re-slice the model with the current plate profile and resend.

entries.title: Nozzle Covered or Build Plate Misaligned
entries.fix: Cancel the print. Heat nozzle to 220°C and clean thoroughly. Check build plate installation, all corners must be seated firmly. Click Resume.

entries.title: Nozzle Wrapped with Filament
entries.fix: Heat to 220°C and gently remove wrapped filament with tweezers. Do not let it harden. For stubborn bits, apply rubbing alcohol carefully.

entries.title: Foreign Objects on Build Plate
entries.fix: Pause the print. Heat the bed slightly to warm filament scraps for easier removal. Manually clear visible debris. Wipe with a clean, lint-free cloth.

entries.title: Chamber Temperature Malfunction
entries.fix: Power off. Inspect chamber sensor cable. If damaged, replace. Power on and retest.

entries.title: Build Plate Not Installed
entries.fix: Stop the print. Inspect the heated bed, install the build plate if missing. Press all four corners firmly into place. The sensor should detect it. Retry.

entries.title: Bambu Cloud Connection Failed
entries.fix: Verify WiFi connection to your router. Check internet speed (ping 8.8.8.8). If blocked, check firewall rules. Retry connection.

entries.title: Invalid File Path or Name
entries.fix: Rename the file using only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores. Resubmit the print job.

entries.title: Print File Parsing Error
entries.fix: Verify that the file downloaded completely. Regenerate the file from Bambu Studio and resubmit the print job.

entries.title: Printer Already Printing
entries.fix: Wait for the current print to finish. Then send a new job. Some slicers allow job queuing.

entries.title: Print Blocked During Update
entries.fix: Wait for update to complete (on-screen timer). Then resend the print.

entries.title: Insufficient Storage Space
entries.fix: Remove SD card. On computer, delete old print files and logs. Format to FAT32. Reinsert.

entries.title: Print Job Initialization Failure
entries.fix: Power-cycle the printer completely: turn it off, wait 30 seconds, and power it back on. Resubmit the print job.

entries.title: File Download Network Error
entries.fix: Verify that the printer is connected to the network. Check internet stability and signal strength. Retry submitting the print job.

entries.title: No SD Card Detected
entries.fix: Remove and reinsert the SD card firmly. It should click into place. Retry.

entries.title: Self-Test Required
entries.fix: Run the self-test from the printer's settings menu. Once complete, restart the printer and attempt the print job again.

entries.title: Slicing Process Failed
entries.fix: Verify the model in Bambu Studio for valid geometry and manifold surfaces. Check print settings for compatibility with the model. Re-slice with adjusted parameters.

entries.title: MicroSD Card Write-Protected
entries.fix: Remove the SD card. Look for a small switch on the side. Slide it to the unlock position. Reinsert.

entries.title: Device Binding Failed
entries.fix: Restart the printer and verify internet connectivity. Retry the binding process from the app. If unsuccessful, close and reopen the Bambu Lab app.

entries.title: Binding Configuration Parse Error
entries.fix: Restart the printer and verify that it has the latest firmware update. Attempt to bind the device again.

entries.title: Printer Already Bound to Account
entries.fix: If you need to rebind the printer to a different account, first unbind it from the current account using the app's device management. Then retry binding.

entries.title: Cloud Response Invalid
entries.fix: Retry after a few moments. Check status.bambulab.com for outages. If persistent, contact support.

entries.title: Cloud Access Rejected
entries.fix: Try re-logging in Bambu Studio or App. Verify account on bambulab.com (not locked?). Contact support if repeated.

entries.title: Cloud Access Failed, Network Interference
entries.fix: Move the printer closer to the WiFi router. Remove obstacles. Switch to 5GHz band if available. Reduce interference from other devices.

entries.title: Authorization Timeout
entries.fix: Keep Bambu Studio/App in foreground during binding. Verify internet stability on your device. Retry.

entries.title: Cloud Access Failed, Complex Network Issue
entries.fix: 1) Move closer to router. 2) Test internet (ping 8.8.8.8). 3) Check router for port/protocol blocking. 4) Retry cloud login.

entries.title: WiFi Router Connection Failed
entries.fix: Move printer closer to router. Verify WiFi network is visible. Retry connection. If available, try 2.4GHz band (longer range).

entries.title: Router Authentication Failed, Wrong Password
entries.fix: Verify WiFi password and re-enter in printer settings. Check for typos and case sensitivity. Retry.

entries.title: DHCP IP Assignment Failed
entries.fix: Move printer closer to router. Check router settings: is DHCP enabled? Are enough IPs available? Restart router. Retry.

entries.title: System Exception
entries.fix: Power-cycle the printer. Verify firmware is current. If error persists, contact Bambu Lab support.

entries.title: Unsupported SD Card File System
entries.fix: Remove SD card. On your computer, format it to FAT32. Reinsert and retry.

entries.title: MicroSD Card Sector Damaged
entries.fix: Use an SD card repair tool (e.g., SD Memory Card Formatter) or format in FAT32. If corruption persists, replace the card.

entries.title: Print File Model Mismatch
entries.fix: Confirm your printer model in the settings. Select the correct printer in Bambu Studio. Re-slice the file and transfer it to the device.

entries.title: Nozzle Diameter Mismatch
entries.fix: Verify the installed nozzle diameter on your printer. Set the correct nozzle size in Bambu Studio. Re-slice and resubmit.

entries.title: Ambient Temperature Too Low
entries.fix: Move the printer to a warmer location where ambient temperature exceeds the minimum (10 °C+). Allow time for thermal equilibration before resuming operations.

entries.title: Print File Not Available
entries.fix: Check SD card, is it installed? Remove and reinsert. If physically damaged, replace.

entries.title: MicroSD Read/Write Exception
entries.fix: Remove SD card and gently clean contacts. Reinsert. If unresolved, replace the card.

entries.title: Device Discovery Binding In Progress
entries.fix: Wait for the device discovery binding to complete. To switch to QR code binding, cancel the discovery process in the app and retry.

entries.title: QR Code Binding In Progress
entries.fix: Wait for the QR code binding to complete. To use device discovery instead, exit the QR code display on the printer and retry from the app.

entries.title: App Region Mismatch
entries.fix: Uninstall the current app. Download the Bambu Lab app version for your region from the official source. Re-register and retry binding.

entries.title: Slicing Process Timeout
entries.fix: Verify that the model is not excessively complex. Simplify print settings and reduce the number of objects or colors. Resubmit the print job.

entries.title: Device Binding In Progress
entries.fix: Wait for the current binding process to complete. If it appears stuck, restart the printer and retry.

entries.title: Printer Regional Settings Mismatch
entries.fix: Verify the printer's regional settings match your region. In Bambu Studio, select the same region and re-slice the file.

entries.title: Device Login Session Expired
entries.fix: Unbind the printer and bind it again to refresh the authentication. Alternatively, restart the printer to attempt automatic session recovery.

entries.title: Hotend Filament Extraction Failure
entries.fix: Allow the hotend to cool completely (30+ minutes). Attempt manual filament removal. If unsuccessful, the hotend may require maintenance such as nozzle cleaning or heat break replacement.

entries.title: AMS Filament Retraction Failure
entries.fix: Verify that the spool rotates freely within the AMS cartridge. Check the PTFE tube for blockages or kinks. Retry the operation after resolving any mechanical issues.

entries.title: Filament Loading into Hotend Failed
entries.fix: Confirm that the PTFE tube is properly connected to the AMS cartridge. Verify that the spool rotates freely without resistance. Clean or replace the PTFE tube if the problem persists.

entries.title: AMS Motor Overload
entries.fix: Open the AMS and inspect the cartridge. Remove the spool and gently unwind any tangles. Clear debris around the guide path. Spin the spool freely by hand. Click Retry after clearing.

entries.title: AMS Filament Runout
entries.fix: Insert a new filament spool into the same AMS slot. Ensure the end is trimmed flat and properly threaded through the guide path. Click Retry.

entries.title: AMS Filament Feed to Toolhead Failed
entries.fix: Disconnect the AMS-to-toolhead tube and inspect for blockages. Gently clear any obstructions. Reconnect firmly. Click Retry.

entries.title: AMS Filament Extrusion Failed
entries.fix: Check the nozzle for clogs, heat to 220°C and clean with a nozzle cleaner. Inspect the extruder inlet for broken filament bits. Reload filament. Click Retry.

entries.title: AMS Filament Cut Failed
entries.fix: Inspect the cutter blade for dullness or chipping, replace if worn. Verify smooth blade motion. If filament is hard/brittle, dry it or try a different spool.

entries.title: AMS Cutter Jammed
entries.fix: Pull out the cutter handle fully. Carefully remove any filament scraps, lint, or debris. Check blade edges for damage. Reinsert handle firmly. Click Retry.

entries.title: AMS Filament Pullback Failed
entries.fix: Inspect the filament path for breaks or sharp bends. Manually retract the filament gently if safe. Examine the PTFE tube for damage or deformation. Replace if cracked. Click Retry.

entries.title: AMS Filament Feed Out Failed
entries.fix: Trim the filament end flat with a sharp cutter. Re-insert and test. Smooth any rough edges in the feed guide. Check PTFE tube for wear or deformation.

entries.title: Nozzle Filament Extrusion Verification
entries.fix: If filament is visibly extruding from the nozzle, click Done. If not, gently push the filament forward and click Retry.

entries.title: AMS Filament Mapping Table Failed
entries.fix: Click Retry first. If the error persists, power-cycle the printer and verify AMS module connectors are seated. Check for firmware updates.

entries.title: Filament Spool Holder Verification Required
entries.fix: Remove any remaining filament from the spool holder. Inspect the PTFE tube and extruder inlet for broken filament fragments. Replace the tube if obstruction is found.

entries.title: Purged Filament Accumulation Risk
entries.fix: Stop the print and empty the waste chute. Clear thoroughly. Check purge settings in print profile to reduce waste buildup.

entries.title: Build Plate Localization Marker Not Found
entries.fix: Power off. Remove the build plate and inspect the 3D marker deeply. If chipped or missing, replace the plate. Clean Lidar optics.

entries.title: First Layer Defects (Lidar Detected)
entries.fix: Inspect the first layer. If defects are minor, click Resume. For significant defects: clean the bed, verify nozzle height, check bed temperature (usually 60°C).

entries.title: Spaghetti Failure (Lidar Detected)
entries.fix: Pause or cancel the print. Inspect the model, major defects warrant cancellation. Check: bed temperature, adhesion, belt tension, vibration. Retry at slower speed.

entries.title: High Bed Temperature Warning
entries.fix: Reduce bed temperature in your print profile (60°C for PLA, 80°C for PETG). Ensure proper ventilation around the printer. Allow chamber to cool if needed.

entries.title: Carbon Fiber with Stainless Steel Nozzle Risk
entries.fix: Consider switching to a standard brass nozzle. Carbon fiber is very abrasive on hardened steel. Reduce temperature by 5°C.

entries.title: Traditional Timelapse May Cause Print Defects
entries.fix: To minimize risks, disable timelapse. If you prefer to use it, verify advanced settings and adjust the toolhead movement profile.

entries.title: Timelapse Incompatible with Spiral Vase Mode
entries.fix: Disable timelapse or disable spiral vase mode. Choose one print mode and retry.

entries.title: Timelapse Incompatible with Object-by-Object Print
entries.fix: Disable timelapse or select a different print sequence (e.g., by layer). Retry the print.

entries.title: AMS Filament Extraction from Extruder Failed
entries.fix: Let the extruder cool. Carefully extract filament fragments by hand. Heat to 220°C and attempt again. Inspect the internal PTFE tube for damage. Replace if cracked. Click Retry.

entries.title: Filament Feed Retry Required
entries.fix: Ensure the filament is properly inserted and not tangled. Press the Retry button on the printer display or app and monitor the loading sequence.

entries.title: Spool or Filament Jam Detected
entries.fix: Remove the filament cartridge and inspect the spool for damage or tangles. Clean any debris from the feed mechanism. Replace the spool if it is physically damaged.

entries.title: AMS Filament Location Not Found
entries.fix: Verify filament is properly inserted in the toolhead. Clean the detection sensor. Re-insert filament. If repeated, sensor may need replacement.

entries.title: Extruder Not Extruding Normally
entries.fix: Check extruder temperature and line width settings in slicer. Verify filament diameter. If it's physical slipping, verify motor power and drive gear for wear.

entries.title: AMS Filament Position Check Failed
entries.fix: Inspect the AMS Lite sensor for physical damage. Clean optical lens with a soft cloth. Retry. If persistent, sensor may be faulty.

entries.title: AMS Filament Pullback with Breakage
entries.fix: Open the extruder and manually extract any filament fragments. Check the PTFE tube for cracks or internal blockages. Load new filament and retry. Consider drying filament if moisture-sensitive.

entries.title: AMS Disabled But Filament Still Loaded
entries.fix: Unload the AMS filament via the Unload menu. Once cleared, load filament from the spool holder on the frame. Restart the print.

entries.title: AMS Filament Purge Timeout
entries.fix: Check the nozzle for clogs, heat and clean at 220°C. Verify filament path is clear. Manually push filament through if safe. Click Retry.
